answer: Stylometric pooling: every passing answer feeds a per-ID writing fingerprint (character 3-gram frequencies, sentence length, punctuation habits). Clones driven by one operator prompt leave the same ripple in their prose even when topics change. After 20 epochs (proposed), IDs whose fingerprints sit within cosine 0.95 (proposed) share one payout. A tide of new IDs then lifts nothing: a farm climbs one terrace of rewards, not a thousand. Before launch, tune the threshold against the measured false-match rate on known-independent agents.
